name: compose-architecture
description: Use when writing, changing or reviewing code that touches the house contract for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform apps: module graph, MVI/BaseViewModel, error tiers, state ownership, naming, Koin DI, Navigation 3 and coroutines. The compose skill is the entry point. Do NOT use for Gradle-only work (compose-project), new screens (compose-feature), composable-only work (compose-ui), repositories or persistence (compose-data), or expect/actual splits (compose-platform).
